SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR('2007', "T1"."dRebounds") > 2007 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100) / COUNT("T1"."playerID") FROM "players_teams" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "players" AS "T2" ON "T1"."playerID" = "T2"."playerID" WHERE "T1"."year" BETWEEN 1990 AND 1990 AND "T1"."year" = 1990

SELECT SUM("T1"."podcast_id") FROM "reviews" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "podcasts" AS "T2" ON "T1"."podcast_id" = "T2"."podcast_id" WHERE "T1"."created_at" = '2022-06-01 00:00:00' AND "T2"."title" = 'Run at in June 2022'
SELECT "T2"."GEOID", "T2"."A_VAR11", "T2"."A_VAR17" FROM "Customers" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "Demog" AS "T2" ON "T1"."ID" = "T2"."A_VAR14" WHERE "T1"."EDUCATIONNUM" = 6 AND "T2"."A_VAR16" > 6

SELECT "T2"."hero", "T2"."song", "T2"."villian" FROM "voice-actors" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "characters" AS "T2" ON "T1"."movie" = "T2"."movie_title" WHERE "T2"."release_date" = 'Wolfgang Reitherman' AND "T2"."release_date" LIKE '1997%'
SELECT DISTINCT "T1"."device_model" FROM "phone_brand_device_model2" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "events" AS "T2" ON "T1"."device_id" = "T2"."device_id" WHERE "T1"."phone_brand" = 'OPPO'
SELECT "T1"."p_id" FROM "taughtBy" AS "T1" GROUP BY "T1"."p_id" ORDER BY COUNT("T1"."course_id") DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT("T2"."business_id") FROM "businesses" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "inspections" AS "T2" ON "T1"."business_id" = "T2"."business_id" WHERE "T2"."type" = 'Routine' AND "T2"."score" > 70

SELECT "T1"."user_id", "T1"."user_votes_useful" FROM "Users" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "Elite" AS "T2" ON "T1"."user_id" = "T2"."user_id" WHERE "T1"."user_yelping_since_year" = 2004 AND "T2"."year_id" = 2004
SELECT "T1"."Country_Name" FROM "Country" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "Player" AS "T2" ON "T1"."Country_Id" = "T2"."Country_Name" ORDER BY "T2"."DOB" LIMIT 1
